transcript_segments.text: their sentences i almost reach they hover just beneath release
like mass without the push to leave held inside what i can't speak
i feel the shape of what i mean before it forms in anything
a constellation in my chest but never mapped beyond my breath
i calculate i hesitate too much drag too much weight
every word i try to send falls back down before it bends toward you
i wonder if you ever knew how close they came to breaking through
i don't reach escape velocity my thoughts collapse back into me
call the night on gravity before they cross the space between
what could have been just out of range a different life if i could say
the thing that almost made their way but never carried far enough away
i replay every homeless line the ones that stalled in real time
job interviews in quiet rooms where better words might have reserved
a different version of my name spoken clear instead of strange relationships
that slipped the frame before articulation came too late
if i had force enough to ascend would anything have changed back then
i don't reach escape velocity my thoughts collapse back into me
every chance that couldn't be burned up in proximity
what could have been just opposite a slight adjustment different flight
if i could push past what confines what's something else up in my life
it's not that nothing's there it's that it never travels
far enough to matter somewhere between intention
and expression there's a threshold i never cross
maybe silence isn't void just a field i can't avoid
where meaning gathers dense and slow
but never finds the force to go maybe i was built this way
high mass low release array a thousand thoughts that never leave
orbiting internally still here
i don't reach escape velocity but something still remains in me
not every truth is meant to be transmitted through proximity
what could have been still resonates in quieter unspoken states
just held in different ways the signal drifting never fully erased
if you felt it even faintly through the pull of what stayed in me
then maybe distance isn't loss just a measure of the cost
of never leaving gravity
